control_rows.finding: Eleven of 37 reporting states and territories exceeded the $8,497 IIJA average-cost limit by more than 50 percent as of 2023 year-end; front-loaded costs may decline over time.
control_rows.existing_response: DOE monitored thresholds, issued a calculator and budget-flexibility guidance, and targeted completion by December 31, 2025.

control_rows.finding: Twenty-one of 53 approved states and territories missed the December 2023 quarterly reporting deadline, with similar prior-quarter results.
control_rows.existing_response: DOE planned trend monitoring, corrective-action plans, increased technical visits, and twice-quarterly execution and staffing review by March 31, 2025.

control_rows.finding: Sixteen approved and funded states and territories reported no completed IIJA units at 2023 year-end, covering 52,386 planned units.
control_rows.existing_response: DOE required zero-completion grantees to submit corrective-action plans and tied remaining obligated funds to progress requirements beginning with December 2024 reports.

control_rows.finding: Wisconsin lacked retained invoices for portions of a judgmental 30-unit sample, creating support and allowability risk without a quantified questioned-cost amount.
control_rows.existing_response: DOE and Wisconsin proposed stronger subaward record language, monitoring, access, and an alternative compliance solution; OIG found the response responsive.

control_rows.finding: Wisconsin did not identify a potential organizational conflict because its policy was not sufficiently rigorous.
control_rows.existing_response: DOE and Wisconsin agreed to strengthen the policy and implement best practices; OIG found planned actions responsive.

control_rows.finding: Wisconsin lacked documented standard procedures for its performance tool and complaint receipt and resolution.
control_rows.existing_response: Wisconsin began formalizing the performance process and developed complaint procedures; OIG found the response responsive.
